source_fact: run_thf_engine_sgp.sh execs python -m veteran_desk.engine_supervisor. That module is not in this repository. The unit MainPID is the supervisor. vd_engine is its child. A fresh supervisor PID does not prove book.py or gate_v2.py was imported.
do_not: stop or restart the tick timer
why_restart_is_unsafe: The leftover supervisor is outside the unit cgroup, so the 20:12 restart left it alive. It is the parent of the only reported daemon. A second restart can kill nothing in that session and can also spawn another daemon from the new official supervisor.
stops: The tick owns stops. Leave tfo-thf-tick.timer running. Firm-risk PID 337359 is exec_speed risk-serve and stays up.
